tasks.title: Health Check & Database Connectivity
acceptanceCriteria: Reports MySQL status, timestamp, and emulator loopback URL

tasks.title: YouTube Search Endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/search?q={query} returns list of songs with title, artist, duration, coverArt
Handles empty queries gracefully with 400 status

tasks.title: Audio Stream Extraction & Resolution
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/stream/:videoId resolves playable audio stream URL

tasks.title: User Authentication & JWT Tokens
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/auth/register creates user with hashed password
POST /api/auth/login verifies credentials and issues valid JWT

tasks.title: Favorites and Playlists API
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create playlists and attach tracks

tasks.title: Automatic Song Metadata Caching
acceptanceCriteria: When a track is searched or streamed, cache title, artist, cover art, and duration in `songs_cache`
Use `INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE` to avoid redundant queries
tasks.verificationCommand: node -e "const db = require('./backend/src/config/db'); console.log('DB check passed');"

tasks.title: Rate Limiting & Abuse Prevention Middleware
acceptanceCriteria: Add IP-based rate limiting to prevent spam on audio stream endpoints
Return HTTP 429 with standard Retry-After headers when exceeded

tasks.title: Automated Code Review Gate (CodeRabbit Sim)
acceptanceCriteria: Static inspection script scans staged/modified JS files
Detects SQL injection risks, missing catch blocks, and exposed tokens
Exits with non-zero code if critical violations are found
